status: fixed before any extension result was computed; this is an analysis-fixation record, not a preregistration: the held-out days 10-12 were already inspected in earlier rounds
forecaster: one-step persistence, causal (forecast for t uses demand up to t-1)

guard.rule: identical to audit/recompute_verified_rank_ablation.py for every margin family

cost.note: unchanged from the paper; not tuned

gaussian.z_note: fixed grid {1.28,1.64,1.96,2.3263,3,4} plus exact nominal z_0.95 and z_0.99; 2.3263 deduplicated into exact z_0.99

reactive.grid: thresholds {0.50,0.60,0.70,0.80,0.85,0.90,0.95,0.99} x cooldowns {1,3,5,10}, existing simulator and saved trajectories

cohorts.Q3Q4: upper half by days 0-9 mean demand (not floor-free)
cohorts.Q4: upper quarter by days 0-9 mean demand

metrics.primary_x: normalised resource cost r_s = C_res(policy,s) / C_res(observed,s); C_res(observed,s) = sum_t max(ceil(replica_count_t),1) over days 10-12; same denominator for every policy of service s
metrics.aggregation: arithmetic mean over services of r_s (mean of ratios); secondary: pooled ratio sum_s C_res(policy,s)/sum_s C_res(observed,s)
metrics.churn: C_act reported separately, normalised by the same C_res(observed,s)
metrics.y: mean over services of the realised held-out overload fraction; service compliance at each evaluation budget is secondary
metrics.secondary_cost: original relative replay cost C_replay(policy)/C_replay(observed), kept for comparability

pretest_selected_points.rule: per service, replay on days 8-9 with days 0-7 persistence warm start; choose minimum calibration relative replay cost among configurations with calibration overload <= evaluation budget; ties: lower overload, then smaller parameter; if none feasible: minimum overload, then cost, then larger parameter
pretest_selected_points.conformal: rank_delta equal to the evaluation budget; alpha grid; guard fixed per selected point (two points: off, on)
pretest_selected_points.gaussian: z grid; guard fixed per selected point (two points: off, on)
pretest_selected_points.reactive: existing B1 rule (cost, overload, threshold desc, cooldown asc; fallback overload, cost, threshold desc, cooldown asc) at the evaluation budget
pretest_selected_points.test_use: evaluated once on days 10-12; nothing selected on days 10-12

envelope.type: descriptive, test-selected; fleet-uniform configurations only (same parameters for every service of a cohort)
envelope.caps: 30 equally spaced caps on cohort-mean normalised resource cost between the minimum and maximum over all fleet-uniform configurations of all families in that cohort
envelope.statistic: per family and cap: minimum mean overload and maximum compliance among configurations with mean normalised resource cost <= cap; missing if none; no interpolation
envelope.interpretation: not a deployable optimum and not a proven Pareto frontier

inference: descriptive only; no new hypothesis tests or significance claims
reproduction_checks: alpha=1 conformal and nominal-z Gaussian rows reproduce audit/verified_results/rank_ablation/rank_ablation_per_service.csv (atol 1e-12)
reactive saved rows satisfy total_cost = c_res*mean_capacity*T + c_act*churn + c_vio*overload*T
reactive pre-test selection at 5% reproduces reactive_selected_parameters.csv; at 1% reproduces strict_budget_per_service.csv reactive rows
causality: forecast and window at t use only demand up to t-1
not_changed: forecasters, models, splits, demand proxy, mu, W=240 primary policy, original results
